title: Man-made UFO down in Russia
summary: Steven Greer tells of Man-made UFO down in Russia, about recent at Russia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: uh apparently a man-made UFO that went down in Russia. We've gotten that confirmed recently from a [snorts] special operations team.

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who pushes for governments to reveal what they know about UFOs, says a man-made UFO, meaning a craft of that kind built by humans, went down in Russia. He says his group recently got this confirmed by a special operations team, a unit of elite soldiers. If true, it would mean humans are already building and flying such craft.
